t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Different gnomes correspond to different coloured baskets. Sometimes the yellow basket has more mushrooms and sometimes the red basket has more. There are x5 multiplier which lead to more mushrooms. You should switch between red and yellow baskets and try to earn the highest amount of mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: There are eight different coloured gnomes that you will encounter. Four of them are assigned to a yellow basket and four of them are assigned to a red basket. This does not change throughout the game. However, sometimes the yellow baskets are worth more and sometimes the red baskets are worth more. When one colour basket starts decreasing in value you should start to choose gnomes that correspond to the other colour basket instead and see if you can earn more. There with either be a 1x multiplier or a 5x multiplier. Make sure you try and maximise the amount of mushrooms on the 5x multiplier rounds and get familiar with which basket earns more during the 1x multiplier rounds. Good luck.
